development-area: What kind of buildings will a tutor find in Development Area?

Mostly reinforced-concrete buildings of four or five storeys, with a few older wooden houses still standing. The plan from the Urban Development and Housing Department describes this Gangtok Municipal Corporation ward as a mix of homes, offices, banks and public buildings, so a flat may sit above an office.
How should we guide a tutor to our flat in Development Area?

Send the building name, the floor and whether the entrance is at road level or down a flight of steps. Buildings line steep roads here, and a first-time visitor can easily walk past the right door. A quick call when the tutor reaches the road also helps.
Is there any rail link a tutor can use to reach Development Area?

No, Gangtok has no railway or metro. Tutors come by shared taxi, on a two-wheeler or on foot from nearby wards such as Arithang and Tibet Road. Evening traffic on the central roads is heavy, so a fixed slot with a little margin keeps lessons on time.
Who does NXTutors suggest first for a home in Development Area?

Tutors who live closest come first. NXTutors builds a shortlist of two or three, starting with tutors in Development Area, then the rest of Central Gangtok & Tibet Road, then the wider city, and finally online tutors. You see each fee on the profile before choosing who takes the free demo.
arithang: Does this page cover both Arithang-I and Arithang-II?

Yes. Arithang is split into two municipal wards, Arithang-I and Arithang-II, and this page covers the whole suburb. Mention which ward you live in along with a roadside landmark, because homes on the hillside can be hard to find from the road alone.
What sort of homes does a tutor visit in Arithang?

Mostly flats in reinforced-concrete buildings set into the hillside, with some smaller, older houses between them. The city development plan notes that many homes here are rented and that shops have been coming up along the roads. Your front door may be several flights above or below the road.
Can a tutor teaching in central Gangtok fit in an Arithang student the same evening?

Often, yes. Arithang lies right next to the core urban area, so a tutor with a class in Development Area or on Tibet Road can add an Arithang lesson without a long trip. Parking on the narrow, steep roads is limited, so most come by shared taxi and walk.
How are tutor fees shown to an Arithang family on NXTutors?

Each tutor's fee is on the profile before you book the free demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Tutors set their own rates.
tibet-road: Why is the area called Tibet Road?

It takes its name from the old trade route to Tibet, along which mules once carried goods. It now lies just off the main shopping street and is one of the most densely built parts of the city, with homes, offices and public buildings side by side.
Where do families on Tibet Road usually live?

Often in flats above or behind shops, in reinforced-concrete buildings with a few older wooden houses among them. Give the tutor the building name and a nearby shop or junction as a landmark, since the lanes off the market look alike to a newcomer from Arithang or Pani House.
When is the market around Tibet Road busiest for a tutor's trip?

In the evenings and during holiday seasons, when shoppers fill the main shopping street and the roads around it. A regular weekday slot agreed in advance works better than fixing times on the day, and tutors from Arithang usually walk in from the nearest taxi point because parking is scarce.
If the right Tibet Road tutor lives across town, what does NXTutors offer?

Online lessons with that tutor, or a nearer home tutor. NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, nearest first, and widens to the rest of the city and then online when needed. The first class is a free demo, and switching tutor later costs nothing.
pani-house: Where is Pani House in Gangtok?

Pani House is a hillside ward along the National Highway, with homes built above and below the road and a row of buildings along the highway frontage. It is mainly residential, with few shops, so daily shopping usually means a trip into town.
How does a tutor reach a Pani House home from the highway?

By shared taxi along the highway, then on steps or footpaths up or down to the door. Describe the route from the nearest stop clearly before the first visit. Houses mean the tutor arrives at your doorstep, while larger buildings may need a call from the entrance.
Which time of day suits lessons in Pani House?

A slot before or after the evening rush. The National Highway carries heavy through traffic, so tutors need some margin at that hour, and heavy monsoon rain can slow trips further. Agree a fixed time and keep an online session ready for very wet days.
Can a Pani House family try a tutor before committing?

Yes. The first class with a tutor NXTutors suggests is a free demo, and you see the fee on the profile beforehand. You get two or three matched names to compare, and if you change your mind later, switching tutor costs you nothing.
deorali: Which municipal ward does Deorali belong to?

Deorali falls in the Deorali-Upper Syari ward of the Gangtok Municipal Corporation. It sits on the National Highway along the southern growth axis that runs from Selep towards Ranipool, so tutors from Tadong, Syari and the town centre can all reach it.
What kind of homes are there around Deorali?

Flats above shops on the main road and houses on the lanes above and below it. The city development plan calls Deorali a fast-emerging commercial and institutional hub, with offices, banks and a post office among the homes, so give the tutor a clear building or shop landmark.
Why does Deorali junction matter when we fix a class time?

Because the city development plan names it one of the busiest traffic points in Gangtok and the way into Syari. Plan lessons around the evening peak, and tell the tutor which side of the junction your home is on so they do not cross it twice.
How wide does NXTutors search for a Deorali tutor?

It starts close to home. NXTutors looks first at tutors in Deorali, then across Deorali, Tadong & Ranipool, then the rest of Gangtok, and online last. Two or three matched tutors come back, each with a visible fee, and the first class is a free demo.
tadong: Does this page cover both Upper and Lower Tadong?

Yes. Tadong is made up of Upper and Lower Tadong, and the municipal corporation has Tadong and Tadong 6th Mile wards, with Daragaon-Lumsey alongside. Mention your ward and a highway landmark, such as the Fifth Mile stretch, when you request a tutor.
What housing should a tutor expect in Tadong?

Flats in multi-storey buildings along the highway and houses on the slopes behind them. Give the building name and floor for a flat; for a house on the slope, say where the tutor should leave the shared taxi and which path leads to your door.
How does the Daragaon bazaar stretch affect evening lessons in Tadong?

It can slow them. The city development plan names the Daragaon bazaar stretch as a traffic pinch point, so evening sessions run more smoothly with a tutor who already lives in Tadong or nearby Deorali. Allow extra time in heavy monsoon rain as well.
What does a Tadong family see before the free demo on NXTutors?

The fee on each tutor's profile, along with two or three matched names. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.
ranipool: Where does Ranipool sit in relation to Gangtok?

On the bank of the Ranikhola, at the junction of National Highway 10 and National Highway 717A, inside the municipal corporation as one of its wards. Roads towards Gangtok, Singtam and Pakyong meet here, so taxis and buses are frequent and tutors can reach it easily.
What mix of homes and other buildings is there in Ranipool?

Newer flats and older houses, alongside schools, a science centre and some industrial units. The city development plan lists Ranipool among the fringe areas where most new building is taking place, so a tutor may need the name of a recently built block and a junction landmark.
When should a Ranipool family schedule lessons around junction traffic?

Ideally away from peak hours, when traffic at the junction is heaviest. Agree a fixed slot with some margin and allow extra time on days of heavy rain. A tutor living in Ranipool itself or in nearby Tadong avoids crossing the junction at the busiest time.
Can a Ranipool student learn online through NXTutors for senior classes?

Yes. When the right senior-subject tutor does not live nearby, NXTutors widens the search from Ranipool to the zone, the city and then online tutors. Online or at home, you get two or three matched names, see each fee in advance and start with a free demo.
syari: What kind of housing is common in Syari?

Government staff housing is a large part of Syari. The city development plan notes many state and central government employee quarters on this eastern side of the ridge, along with health centres, offices and government schools, but relatively few shops. It is primarily residential.
What should a tutor do on arriving at a housing colony in Syari?

Give their name at the colony gate or call the family from there. Share the block and quarter number in advance, and say whether the home is in Upper or Lower Syari, so the tutor goes straight to the right building on the first visit.

Through Deorali junction, which the city development plan names as the main bottleneck for this side of the city. Tutors arriving by shared taxi find evening classes slow, so a tutor living in Syari or Deorali is easiest. The roads are steep, and extra time helps in heavy rain.
Can a Syari family change tutor after a few weeks?

Yes, and switching costs nothing on NXTutors. Your request brings two or three matched tutors, nearest first, so there are usually other names to try. Each fee is visible before the free first demo, and the same applies to any new tutor you pick.
chandmari: Where does Chandmari lie within the city?

On the city's eastern slope. Chandmari is a municipal ward, and the city development plan describes a line of settlements growing from Chandmari towards Syari, with homes alongside greenhouses, schools and a telephone office. Tathangchen is its close neighbour, and Syari lies further along the same slope.
How should a tutor find a Chandmari home on the slope?

With directions from the nearest taxi point and a phone number for the first visit. Many houses and residential buildings here are reached by steps or footpaths from the road, so say whether to climb or go down and which landmark marks the path.
Which nearby areas can supply tutors for Chandmari?

Tathangchen and Syari are the closest, and tutors living there can reach Chandmari easily. Most come by shared taxi or two-wheeler. Evening traffic on the bypass and the central roads is heavy, so a fixed weekday slot keeps lessons regular through the term.
How does NXTutors pick tutors for a Chandmari request?

By distance from your home. Tutors living in Chandmari are considered first, then those in neighbouring wards, then the wider city, with online tutors as the last step. NXTutors sends two or three matches, and you can compare their fees before choosing one for the free demo.
tathangchen: Is Tathangchen mainly a residential area?

Mainly, yes. The city development plan describes Tathangchen as mixed in use but mostly homes, with schools, government offices, greenhouses and a power station among them. It is a municipal ward on the eastern side of Gangtok, below the bypass road.
What directions does a tutor need for a Tathangchen home?

The exact path or flight of steps from the road. Homes are spread across the hillside, from houses with their own front door to small residential buildings, so a landmark at road level and a phone call save a tutor from Chandmari or Syari time.
What happens to Tathangchen lessons in weeks of heavy rain?

Many families agree a backup online session. Steep slopes and monsoon rain can slow travel, so tutors coming by taxi or two-wheeler from Chandmari, Syari or the town centre may need extra time. That week's lesson can then move online to keep the child's routine going.
What do home tutors charge for a Tathangchen student on NXTutors?

Tutors set their own fee, shown before the free demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.
sichey: Which parts of Sichey does this page cover?

All three: Upper, Middle and Lower Sichey. The municipal corporation has separate Upper Sichey and Lower Sichey wards, and the bypass road runs through Middle Sichey, so mention your part of Sichey and a landmark when you ask for a tutor.
What is Upper Sichey like for a tutor visiting a family?

Predominantly residential, with the city's football stadium and district administration offices nearby as easy landmarks. Buildings are mostly reinforced concrete, with some wooden houses. Families in flats should share the floor and building name; houses on the slopes may be reached by steps from the road.
When is traffic on the bypass near Sichey heaviest?

At office hours, morning and evening. Pick a weekday lesson slot outside the evening rush and allow extra time in heavy rain. Because Sichey sits on the bypass, tutors from Burtuk, Chandmari and the town centre can reach it without much difficulty.
Does NXTutors suggest only tutors who live in Sichey?

No, though they come first. NXTutors starts with tutors in Sichey, then looks across Sichey, Burtuk & Bojoghari and the rest of Gangtok, and finally at online tutors. You receive two or three names, see every fee before booking and pay nothing for the first demo class.
burtuk: Which tutors are most practical for a Burtuk home?

Tutors already teaching in Sichey or along the bypass. Burtuk is grouped with Sicheygaon and Upper Sicheygaon, so a tutor with classes there can add a Burtuk student without a long extra trip. Ask for this when you send the request.
How do tutors usually get to a Burtuk home?

By shared taxi or two-wheeler, then on foot for the last stretch. Homes stand beside steep roads, so give clear directions and a phone number before the first class, including whether the house is above or below the road and where the tutor should stop.
Is Burtuk still growing as a neighbourhood?

Yes. The city development plan listed Burtuk, now a Gangtok Municipal Corporation ward, among the suburban areas around Gangtok that were growing and needed to be brought into the city's services. For families, that means older houses beside newer buildings, so describe your home clearly to a first-time visitor.
Can NXTutors pair an online tutor with a home tutor for a Burtuk student?

Yes. Some families keep a nearby home tutor for school subjects and add an online tutor for senior science or maths. NXTutors suggests two or three matched tutors for each request, with fees visible before the free demo, and switching later costs nothing.
bojoghari: Which municipal ward is Bojoghari part of?

The Bojoghari-2nd Mile ward of the Gangtok Municipal Corporation. The city development plan named Bojoghari, with Syari, Tathangchen and Chandmari, among the areas around and below the bypass that could absorb some of the city's growth. Tutors from those areas are practical matches.
Where do tutors for Bojoghari usually come from?

Chandmari, Tathangchen, Sichey and the bypass corridor are the most practical places. A tutor living in one of them can make regular visits without a long trip. Most arrive by shared taxi or two-wheeler, so share a landmark and a phone number before the first class.
How are homes laid out in Bojoghari?

Like much of Gangtok, they climb the slopes beside the roads, so a house or building may be reached by steps above or below the road. Tell the tutor which side of the road to look on and where the steps begin, and allow extra time in heavy monsoon rain.
What does a Bojoghari family pay for the first class?

Nothing; the first class is a free demo. NXTutors sends two or three matched tutors, starting with those nearest Bojoghari, and each profile shows the tutor's fee so you can compare before booking. If a tutor stops suiting your child later, you can switch at no cost.
